name: Focused
semantics: One bounded artifact/module or deterministic edit with local tests; minimal shared-contract coupling.

name: Bounded multi-file
semantics: Several related files/tools with clear interfaces and low uncertainty.

name: Cross-cutting bounded
semantics: Touches shared governance/contracts or several modules but has known semantics and finite evidence.

name: Evidence/data dependent
semantics: Requires multi-domain design, source/data evidence, architecture choice or broader integration.

name: Protected/high-risk
semantics: Touches PIT/leakage/promotion/BAS/shared target semantics, protected evaluation, or dependency-critical gates; requires serialized review/evidence.
